PLUGIN.NAME: Obsidian Connector
PLUGIN.DESCRIPTION: Link Super Productivity projects to existing folders in an Obsidian vault.

UI.LEDE: Pick an existing Super Productivity project and link it to an existing folder in your Obsidian vault. Nothing new is created.
UI.VAULT_NAME_HINT: The name shown in Obsidian. Used only to open the folder with obsidian://
UI.VAULT_PATH_HINT: Absolute path to the vault, e.g. /home/you/Obsidian/Work. Needed to list folders. Desktop app only.
UI.PROJECT_HINT: Only projects that already exist in Super Productivity are listed. This plugin never creates a project.
UI.FOLDER_HINT: Choose the vault folder that matches this project. Load folders after setting the vault path.
UI.FOLDER_SEARCH_FOR: Search folders… (matches for "{{title}}" are listed first)
UI.EMPTY: No links yet. Choose an existing project, pick an Obsidian folder, then click Link.
UI.CURRENT_UNLINKED: Not linked to an Obsidian folder yet.
UI.FOLDERS_EMPTY: Set the vault path and click Load folders to see every folder in the vault.

MSG.NO_PROJECT_CONTEXT: Open a project first, then try again.
MSG.PROJECT_NOT_LINKED: This project is not linked to an Obsidian folder yet.
MSG.URI_COPIED: Could not open Obsidian automatically. The URI was copied to the clipboard.
MSG.VAULT_PATH_REQUIRED: Enter the vault folder path on this computer, then load folders.
MSG.DESKTOP_ONLY: Listing Obsidian folders needs the Super Productivity desktop app, with file access allowed for this plugin.
MSG.FOLDERS_FAILED: Could not read the vault folders.
MSG.LOAD_FOLDERS_FIRST: Load the vault folders first, then select the folder that matches this project.
MSG.LINKED: Project linked to the selected Obsidian folder.
MSG.CHOOSE_PROJECT_FIRST: Choose an existing Super Productivity project first.
MSG.CHOOSE_FOLDER: Select an Obsidian folder from the list.
MSG.INVALID_PATH: Choose an existing folder inside the vault (no absolute paths or ..).
MSG.CONFIRM_UNLINK: Remove the Obsidian folder link for "{{title}}"? Nothing in the vault is deleted.
